comments.author: @UnrealWorldJourney1
comments.text: Bhutan is fascinating because it challenges the idea that national progress has to be measured only through economic growth. 🇧🇹🏔 Protecting forests, preserving culture and even adapting infrastructure for wildlife shows how differently a country can define development. Whether the model can work everywhere is another question, but seeing a nation deliberately protect values that are usually sacrificed for growth is incredibly interesting.

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: Beautifully observed — it really makes you rethink what true progress looks like.
